posts.title: How to block TikTok on iPhone (for real)
posts.caption: screen time limits never worked for me. this does. ARCO is free on the App Store. #focus #screentime #productivity #digitaldetox

text: how to block tiktok on iphone (for real).
not screen time limits. those never work.
one tap on 'ignore limit' and you're back in. every time.
tiktok, instagram, whatever eats your day.
they only lock during the hours you set to focus.
the block holds until the block ends. that is the whole point.
i built the app that does this.
it is called ARCO and it just went live.
